brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished approximately 10 livestock and horse shelters in the al-Jawarish neighborhood of Ramla on Tuesday, the Shehab Wire reported. The operation took place in the occupied interior, with National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir present during the demolition.

The demolitions targeted structures used for keeping cattle, sheep, and horses in the residential area. Residents of al-Jawarish have faced repeated home demolitions and property destruction over recent years as part of Israeli policy in Palestinian communities within the 1948 borders. Tuesday's action marks the latest instance of such operations in the densely populated neighborhood.
